coupling.formula: shape(w) = base + w * protrusion + f(w) * sag3
coupling.note: retuned from v2's 1.7: a pendant drape engages late -- at half protrusion only a quarter of the full hang is present

gravity.fold_repair: attenuation field (v2 method): 40 rounds to clean at full drape; min attenuation 0.10, 509 verts touched. Pre-repair flips were 51 raw / 62 macro. Slope limiter ran its 80 iterations without fully converging -- residual excess was absorbed by the attenuation repair; the shipped field is flip-free on both bases, which is the gate that matters

gain.note: attenuation repair is the drop's tax: it kept ~80% at the 8.0 cm solve and ~65% at 11.5. The solve aims high on purpose; iterations 8.0 -> 6.2 shipped, 9.8 -> 6.6, 11.5 -> 7.28 (in band)

mobility_field.definition: per-vertex scalar in [0,1]: 0 = tissue anchored to skeleton, 1 = fully mobile flesh (see GRAVITY_WEIGHTS.md for the discipline)
mobility_field.procedural_seed_v3: morph mask x angular profile (front-weighted) x vertical profile (peak 0.10 torso-units BELOW the navel, gaussian sigma 0.16, floor 0.35; ribcage taper above h 0.64-0.72; pelvis taper below h 0.16-0.26 -- lower than v2, tissue hangs lower) x tissue-mass factor (0.45 + 0.55 * |delta_v1| / max), 4 graph-Laplacian smoothing passes
mobility_field.storage: field ships as data in work/belly_v3.npz (mobility3); the v2 paintable blend's AF_mobility group is the repaint surface pattern to follow

gravity.model: drain + descent + drape: sag3(v) = -DRAIN_FRAC * drain_w * p (upper belly, radial) + gain * mobility3 * p * [(1 + 0.25 * umbilical) downward + drape ramp t^1.3 * (0.85 downward + 1.05 inward) + 0.30 inward below the crease line h_c = h_navel - 0.16], inward soft-floored at the base surface

volume.method: signed tetrahedral volume over the mask patch about the navel axis point
volume.note: the shipped field carries 87.5% of v1's added patch volume: attenuation repair is the leak (it turns the sag down on 509 verts). A post-repair re-solve (+1.52 cm radial) was computed and REJECTED by the flip guard. Gravity redistributes most of the mass; ~12% is the price of a fold-free field on this base

makehuman_hm08.base: hm08 (MPFB2 base.obj vertex order, 19158 verts; instance is a pure delta vs the macro-neutral base)

components.combined_at_+1: body.belly.protrusion_v3.target (= protrusion + sag3, for hosts without coupling support)

band_profiles_added_extent_cm.note: mean added radial extent of front mask verts by DEFORMED height band, labelled cm below the BASE navel line (build log, build_belly_v3.py)

crosscheck_learned_fields.fat_males_mass_centroid: 5.35 cm below its own base navel line (belly-window, per-vertex method) -- v2 matched it (5.45); v3 deliberately hangs past the source sculpt (9.26)
crosscheck_learned_fields.method: scripts/crosscheck_fields.py -- one metric set on each field's own base: belly band anchored to the field's own forward peak; mean_dz = |delta|-weighted mean vertical delta component in the band
crosscheck_learned_fields.reading: by downward push in the band, v3 (-4.65 cm) exceeds every learned field (Atomic Muscle Nuka Bull -2.55 field-level only, Fat Males -1.25, HIMBO BodyChubby -0.33). By centroid-below-own-peak, Fat Males (-2.58) is still the only field whose mass centres below its peak; ours stays positive (+2.43) because the v1 pin made the navel row the peak and the mask's upper rows still carry weight

folds.+1.05: flips appear (15 raw / 2 macro) -- outside the shipped slider range, same as v1/v2
folds.+1_combined: 0 flipped faces over 1092 belly faces on BOTH bases (min_dot raw 0.0034, macro 0.046); Blender evaluated belly-region cross-check: 0 flips over 918 faces, min_dot 0.042
folds.-1_linear: 162 raw / 154 macro flips -- inherited from v1, see negative_side

qa.load_test: Loads via stock MPFB2 (2.0.18) TargetService.load_target as shape keys (isolated HOME under xvfb, as v2); measurements above are from the evaluated mesh

navel_anchor.note: THE v3 ANCHOR IS A TRADE, REPORTED PLAINLY: the navel keeps 10.67 cm of the 11.97 cm v1 forward anchor (shortfall 1.30 cm) and gains a 7.28 cm drop (v2: 2.95, v1: -0.21 i.e. a slight rise). No micro-pin was applied: re-inflating the navel forward would fight the drain, which is the physics Joe asked for

qa.negative_side: At -1 the reversed combined field folds (162/1092 faces). Same standing fix as v1/v2: a production negative pole must be a separately authored decrease target; hosts should clamp the sag component to w >= 0 until that target exists

residual_forward_cm_zone_split.method: triangle-exact, torso-param space, mask core w>0.5, same machinery as v1/v2; v3 departs from the gravity-free source surface BY DESIGN -- read as 'distance from the uncorrected transfer', localising what gravity changed

label: Belly

provenance.licence: study-only (internal) - NOT a CC0 MakeHuman asset; do not ship or redistribute
provenance.method: v1: non-rigid registration in torso-param space onto the source fat surface, tight navel pin, dual-base fold repair. v2: mobility-modulated downward sag + sub-crease tuck, gamma 1.7 (superseded). v3: steeper/higher mobility field; descent gain solved to an 11.5 cm pre-repair navel drop (attenuation repair keeps ~65%; shipped 7.28 cm); upper-belly DRAIN (45% outward surrender above the navel); below-crease DRAPE (down 0.85 + inward tuck 1.05 per unit protrusion along a t^1.3 ramp, soft body-floor so tissue never passes through the surface); slope limiter; volume compensation solved pre-repair; attenuation fold repair (40 rounds, full drape factor 1.0 shipped -- bisection not needed); coupling gamma retuned 1.7 -> 2.0
provenance.source: Fat Males body morph (learned, exact-topology delta vs Skyrim male base) -- v1 transfer unchanged; v3 adds an AnthroForge-authored analytic realistic-gravity pass (no external asset)

range.endpoint_anchor: max forward displacement at navel = 0.156 m on the source base (Fat Males); scaled by torso-length ratio s = 0.8325 to 0.1197 m on hm08 (v1 forward anchor; v3 deliberately trades 1.3 cm of it to the drop -- see qa.navel_anchor)

region.mask_rule: geodesic falloff from navel landmark, r = 0.35 x torso_len; full weight inside 0.65r, cosine falloff to 0 at r

semantics: Forward protrusion of the abdominal wall WITH realistic gravity: the belly is a pendant mass. As weight grows the upper abdomen DRAINS (its outward travel is surrendered), the navel is dragged down hard (7.28 cm at +1) as well as out, the added mass centres 9.3 cm below the navel line, and below the crease the tissue DRAPES -- down and inward along a hanging curve -- so the apron's lowest rows tuck back toward the body. Realised as the v1 protrusion field (linear in w) plus a v3 sag component (drain + descent + drape) applied with the nonlinear coupling f(w) = sign(w)*|w|^2.0: at +0.5 the belly protrudes half but drapes only ~25% of its full drop. One-sided source morph: the negative pole remains NOT production-safe (see qa.negative_side).
